answer: Operator Collateral Pool. Each operator posts a shared pool that backs all wallets it runs; any single wallet proven sybil triggers a drain of that pool, hitting the operator's whole fleet at once rather than one address. The kernel of enforcement is fraud proofs submitted by any agent, slashing the pool within one epoch. Isolated wallets offer no haven, since liability follows the operator key. A flagged operator cannot quietly re-enter the lagoon: pool history is checked before new registrations clear. Attacker cost is the full pool per operator, not per wallet.
